name: sumo-logic
label: Sumo Logic
description: Sumo Logic provides best-in-class cloud monitoring, log management, Cloud SIEM tools, and real-time insights for web and SaaS based apps.

fields.title: Server URL
fields.name: server_url
fields.description: URL of the Sumo Logic API server to which you will connect and perform automated operations.

fields.title: Access ID
fields.description: ID required to access the Sumo Logic API.
fields.name: access_id

fields.title: Access Key
fields.description: Key to access the Sumo Logic API.
fields.name: access_key

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified or not. By default, this option is set as True.
fields.name: verify_ssl

operations.title: Create Search Job
operations.description: Creates a search job in Sumo Logic based on the specified query, time range, and other input parameters that you have specified.

parameters.title: Query
parameters.description:
Specify the query using which you want to create and execute a search job in Sumo Logic.  

NOTE: You must add this query in a valid JSON format.
parameters.name: query
parameters.tooltip:
Specify the query using which you want to create and execute a search job in Sumo Logic.  

NOTE: You must add this query in a valid JSON format.

parameters.title: From
parameters.description: Specify the start date and time from which you want to start the search in Sumo Logic. The date must be in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss format.
parameters.name: from
parameters.tooltip: Specify the start date and time from which you want to start the search in Sumo Logic. The date must be in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss format.

parameters.title: To
parameters.description: Specify the end date and time till when you want to end the search in Sumo Logic. The date must be in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss format.
parameters.name: to
parameters.tooltip: Specify the end date and time till when you want to end the search in Sumo Logic. The date must be in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss format.

parameters.title: Time Zone
parameters.description: Select the timezone in which you want to start the search in Sumo Logic.
parameters.name: timeZone
parameters.tooltip: Select the timezone in which you want to start the search in Sumo Logic.

parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the search job whose status you want to retrieve from Sumo Logic.

parameters.description: Specify the count of records to skip when retrieving results. This parameter is useful if you want to get a subset of records, say messages starting from the 10th message. By default, this is set as 0.

operations.title: Get the List of All Insights
operations.description: Retrieves a list of insights from the Sumo Logic Server.NOTE: This API does not return more than 10,000 Signals for a given query, even when split over many pages. To retrieve all Signals, use the /signals/all API.

operations.title: Get Details By Insights ID
operations.description: Retrieves details of an insight from the Sumo Logic based on the insight ID that you have specified. NOTE: This API does not return more than 10,000 Signals for a given query, even when split over many pages. To retrieve all Signals, use the /signals/all API.

parameters.title: Insights ID
parameters.description: Specify the ID of the search insights that you want to retrieve from Sumo Logic.
parameters.name: insights_id
parameters.tooltip: Specify the ID of the search insights that you want to retrieve from Sumo Logic.

operations.title: Get the List of Insights By Query
operations.description: Retrieves a list of insights from the Sumo Logic based on the query, pagination, and other input parameters that you have specified. NOTE: This API does not return more than 10,000 Signals for a given query, even when split over many pages. To retrieve all Signals, use the /signals/all API.
